win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new symbols drop down to fill the empty spaces.

wilds.name: BLESSING BAR
wilds.behavior:
A Blessing Bar is located outside the grid which awards Wild symbols and Multipliers on those Wild symbols when full. When a winning combination lands on the grid, the Blessing Bar will start to fill. An 8-symbol win is needed to fill the Blessing Bar the first time. Then the amount of winning symbols needed will increase by +2 symbols each time you fill the Bar. The Blessing Bar will reset between spins if only partially filled.

 When the Blessing Bar is full, it activates and then resets. When activated, the Blessing Bar awards Wild symbols with a Multiplier value each. On the first activation, the Blessing Bar will start with an award of 3 Wild symbols.

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. When a Wild symbol is part of a win, the Multiplier value is added to all wins connected to that Wild symbol. If more than one Wild symbol with a Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, the values are added together before being applied to the win.

 When the Blessing Bar activates again the number of Wild symbols or the value of the Multiplier that can be awarded will increase upon each subsequent activation. The Wild symbols can increase by 1 each time and the Multiplier value can increase by adding a random Multiplier value to the existing Multiplier on the Blessing Bar. The Additive Multiplier values added to the Blessing Bar can be 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - THE NIGHT COURT
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, the Blessing Bar will stay full throughout the bonus and activate once on every free spin after regular wins have been handled. The awarded Wild symbol will start at 6 and the Multiplier will start at 10x. The awarded Wild or Multiplier value will increase after the Blessing Bar activates on every spin.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land in THE DUSK COURT, THE LUNAR COURT and THE NIGHT COURT bonus.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THE DUSK COURT
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game’s mechanics, with an increased chance of getting more Wild symbols and higher Multiplier values. In addition, the Blessing Bar, the awarded Wild symbols and the Multiplier value are progressive throughout the bonus. The awarded Wild symbols will start at 3 and the Multiplier value will start at 2x.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THE LUNAR COURT
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps mechanics of THE DUSK COURT bonus. In addition, the awarded Wild symbols will start at 4 and the Multiplier value will start at 5x. A 15-symbol win is needed to fill the Blessing Bar the first time. Then the amount of winning symbols needed will increase by +3 symbols each time you fill the Bar.
